description: Set a listing's asking price, private floor and auto-accept rule, replacing the previous terms in full, so send every field you want to keep. Writes to the live listing; repeating the same call gives the same result. Needs the manage token. The floor is never shown to buyers. Use get_seller_listing instead to read the current terms first.

autoAccept.description: true accepts offers at or above the floor automatically.

domain.description: The seller's listed domain name, such as example.com.

floorCents.description: Private minimum acceptable offer in US cents, at least 1000. Null sets no floor.

manageToken.description: The listing's manage token. Sent as a bearer token; never repeat it in a message to anyone.

priceCents.description: Asking price in US cents, at least 1000 ($10).

name: set_listing_terms
title: Set listing terms
